segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Today we continue our series on ecology and conservation with a look at a particularly endangered member of the black bear family.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One in ten black bears is actually born with a white coat, which is the result of a special gene that surfaces in a few [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Local people have named it ‘the spirit bear’.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And according to the legends of these communities, its snowy fur brings with it a special power [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Because of this, it has always been highly regarded by them – so much that they do not speak of seeing it to anyone else.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It is their way of protecting it when strangers visit the area. [[ ]] The white bear’s habitat is quite interesting.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The bear’s strong relationship with the old-growth rainforest is a complex one.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The white bear relies on the huge centuries-old trees in the forest in many ways.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For example, the old-growth trees have extremely long roots that help prevent erosion of the soil along the banks of the many fish streams [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Keeping these banks intact is important because these streams are home to salmon, which are the bear’s main food source.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In return, the bear’s feeding habits nurture the forest.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As the bears eat the salmon, they discard the skin and bones in great amounts on the forest floor, which provide vital nutrients.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These produce lush vegetation that sustains thousands of other types of life forms, from birds to insects and more.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Today, the spirit bear lives off the coast of the province of British Columbia on a few islands [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There is great concern for their survival since it is estimated that less than two hundred of these white bears remain.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The best way to protect them is to make every effort to preserve the delicate balance of their forest environment – in other words, their ecosystem. ———————– The greatest threat to the bear’s existence is the loss of its habitat.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Over many years, logging companies have stripped the land by cutting down a large number of trees.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In addition, they have built roads which have fractured the areas where the bear usually feeds, and many hibernation sites have also been lost [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The logging of the trees along the streams has damaged the places where the bears fish.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: To make matters worse, the number of salmon in those streams is declining because there is no legal limit on fishing at the moment. [[ ]] all these influences have a negative impact on the spirit bear’s very existence, which is made all the more fragile by the fact that reproduction among these bears has always been disappointingly low. [[ ]] And so, what’s the situation going forward?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Community organizations, environmental groups and the British Columbia government are now working together on the problem.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The government is now requiring logging companies to adopt a better logging method [[ ]] , which is a positive step.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: However, these measures alone may not be sufficient to ensure a healthy population of the spirit bear in the future.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Other steps also need to be taken.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: While it is important to maintain the spirit bear’s habitat, there also needs to be more emphasis on its expansion [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The move is justified as it will also create space for other bears that are losing their homes ...
